title: Finally

inlines.v: FI'NALLY, adverb 1. At the end or conclusion; ultimately; lastly. The cause is expensive, but we shall finally recover. The contest was long, but the Romans finally conquered. 2. Completely; beyond recovery. The enemy was finally exterminated.
